notes.title: Version 0.9.2.0 - Growth of cities, laws and achievements
notes.notes:
Hello friends! A really big update came out today, it took a lot of time and effort. The new version 0.9.2.0 adds a system for the development and growth of cities, a system of laws and achievements. Saves from older versions work correctly.

[b]New city system[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the city will gradually grow from a small village to a large city.
[*] After loading saves from old versions of the city will be at an average level of development
[*] Population will appear in cities, which will grow or fall depending on the situation in the city. For example, from the amount of taxes
[*] The size of the city will increase with the population
[*] The image on the map will change depending on the size of the city
[*] "Happiness" appears in the city. The higher this parameter, the more willingly people move to the city and pay taxes.
[*] Cities can now revolt. If the mood in the city reaches -100, a revolt will start and the inhabitants will declare their settlement independent
[*] All residents of the city pay taxes. The happier they are, the more money they will pay
[*] The previous tax system is still in effect - factory owners also give part of the produced goods to the city
[*] Laws appeared in the cities - now the rulers can manage their city as they please
[*] Added random events in the city. For example, famous artists may arrive, a plague may begin, or beer will run out. All of these events affect population, happiness, and income.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39895511/968ef61b733aa5e92f7aa82d7a05c40fd2ffe7bd.png[/img]

[b]Corrections and other improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: problem with saving tax levels
[*] Fixed: adding city tax for the second time
[*] Improved survival of characters
[*] Improved survival rate for children under 18
[*] Updated: displaying information about cities in the general list of the kingdom
[*] Added: city robbery imposes a certain negative trait
[*] Added: events related to the city
[*] Added: laws that can be adopted in the city
[*] Added: display if a riot is expected or the city has reached the maximum population
[*] Added and fixed some hints
[*] Fixed: the dialogue about the growing up of a non-native child has been removed
[*] Many minor fixes
[/list]

[b]Achievements[/b]

Well, the tasty part. What players have been asking for a long time are achievements. At the moment there are 26, but in the future, I hope to increase their number. I tried to create interesting achievements that really require serious effort. Some of them are quite complex and will be a real challenge to the player. But the greater the joy from the completed achievement, which can be shared with other players and friends

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39895511/96ae176b3fe81d0ea71ce634cdb37988e676529d.png[/img]

Friends, thank you so much for your support. Commenting, making interesting suggestions and leaving positive feedback is incredibly energizing for new interesting ideas and achievements. I thank you for everything! You are best!

notes.title: Version 0.9.0.0 - Turn-based combat
notes.notes:
Hello friends! It's time for a new version 0.9.0.0 and a major update. Time for a turn based combat system - an all-new combat mode. This is a really big event for all of us.

Now the game has 2 completely different battle modes - the good old battle in real time (arcade mode) and the new one - turn-based. You choose how you want to fight the battle. Both modes bring the same rewards and results.

The new fight will get even better. I am waiting for your feedback and suggestions. I want to thank all of you for your anticipation and support.

And one more good news - the game is participating in the upcoming Halloween sale. I wish you all a great mood and an exciting game.

P.S. And finally, I'll tell you about the rules of turn-based combat. You can find the same instructions in the game. 

The goal is to destroy all opponents

The battlefield is divided into two parts. The left one is yours, the right one is the enemy.
Leaders enter the battlefield automatically.

A character is randomly selected. He decides who is the first to deploy the troops and attack. Another character builds his army depending on the location of the enemy.

Reinforcements can be summoned on your turn to your part of the battlefield
[list]
[*]  To the first line next to the enemy
[*]  On the line where your troops are located
[*]  In front of your fighters and behind them
[*]  There can be no empty lines between fighters
[*]  If there is an empty space between the lines of fighters - fighters move to the center of the field
[/list]

After being summoned, a fighter can only act on the next turn.
A fighter can use 1 skill for each weapon 1 time per turn. Each Skill requires Energy. (If Skill is required more than maximum and Energy is greater than 0 - Skill can be used)

Skills have different ranges
[list]
[*]  Melee - 1 line,
[*]  Spears - 1 and 2 lines,
[*]  Bows and pistols - 2 and 3
[*]  Shotguns - 2, 3 and 4
[*]  You can attack any character on the line.
[/list]
Ranged weapons cannot shoot at close range (Melee only possible)

The "Meditation" skill restores maximum Energy (the character must have at least one unused weapon)
After that, the character cannot use skills until the end of the turn.

Armor reduces damage by its own amount
The Raise Shield skill grants damage absorption until the next turn.
Damage cannot be less than 1

In melee combat, the enemy responds to the blow (Uses Skill)
If there are no available Skills - Riposte strike is not used

A flank strike is applied if the opponent is to the left or right in the line. (There should not be an ally next to the enemy)
Flanking deals 50% more damage.
Riposte strike cannot be Flank strike

notes.title: Version 0.8.3.1. Recruitment system. Escape from the battlefield

Hello friends! We have a new version 0.8.3.1 which adds new features. Saves from older versions will work correctly.

New mercenary system. New mercenaries come to each city once a month. They can be hired at the tavern. If you have a factory or city, there is a separate recruitment button from the same list. You can freely move mercenaries between your inventory, your city or factory. The monthly fee is only taken for those in your inventory and traveling with you.

A new opportunity is to escape from the battle if it doesn’t work in your favor. Available through the pause menu ("Esc" button in battle). Not available if the character is killed in battle. During the flight, part of the loot and mercenaries (about 35%) will be lost. There will also be added the "Escaped from the battlefield" feature for 15 days. While it is active, it is impossible to escape from the battle again. Following the results of the escape, a window about losses and abandoned things will be shown.

notes.title: Version 0.8.3.0 - Plot system
notes.notes:
Greetings friends.
The new version 0.8.3.0 adds a new big mechanic - the plot system. A little about it.
Each character has 2 actions available - plot to kill or protection from murder.
The plot has been in preparation for several days, currently 40. There is a base chance of a kill success.
The chance and preparation time are influenced by:
[list]
[*] difference in killer rank and target
[*] difference in killer's and target's cunning 
[/list]
You can increase the chance of success and reduce the preparation time for gold 
Protection gives you a chance to prevent murder. You can add it to any character, for example, an heir or a friend. The chance can be increased for gold.

The murder process: 
[list]
[*] kill chance check
[*] if successful, check all defenses of the target, if any
[*] if the defenses fail, the target dies
[*] Was the killer revealed or not? If his name becomes known to everyone, respect falls, and relations with friends and relatives of the murdered person deteriorate. But with enemies, on the contrary, they improve.
[/list]

The new system is available in the full version of the game, which will be released soon (not in demo). Saves from previous versions should work correctly.
Additionally:
[list]
[*] Fixed: a bug of the lord regeneration system
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

Thanks everyone.

notes.notes:
Hello friends. Version 0.8.2.1 is ready. Saves from previous versions should work correctly.

In the new version, you will find a new dungeon system. Previously, a dungeon was a series of connected rooms filled with items and enemies. Now it is a small adventure with a constant choice - to move on and risk health and property, or escape with the available loot.
[list]
[*] Dungeons appear close to the player and disappear after a while
[*] This is now a sequence of rooms with increasing difficulty and loot size
[*] First room - always guarded, but weak
[*] After passing the room, you have the choice to move on or retreat
[*] Each room can be safe or guarded
[*] If there is a guard in the room, you will have to fight or persuade
[*] The last room has the most difficult enemy and the most loot
[*] After leaving the dungeon, starting from the second room, the dungeon will disappear
[*] All of this does not affect dungeons saved in previous versions
[/list]

Some other changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed: Filters "Mercenaries" and "Other" are confused
[*] The inventory window has become larger, the inventory cells are more contrasting
[*] Added sounds for some buttons
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[/list]

Thank you friends. I look forward to your feedback and suggestions. It's very interesting to know your opinion.

notes.title: Version 0.8.2.0 - Lots of balance changes and tweaks to make the game easier
notes.notes:
Hello friends. The new version 0.8.2.0 is waiting for you. Saving from older versions should work fine. Lots of balance changes and tweaks to make the game easier. I hope you will enjoy. I look forward to your feedback and impressions. Thank you.

[list]
[*] Several dungeons are created at the start
[*] Dungeons appear near the character
[*] Dungeons don't disappear right in front of the player
[*] Increased dungeon loot drop rates
[*] Reduced damage from firearms
[*] Restoring a blessing in the city by the tree - free
[*] Reduced blessing cost per day (-1 or -2)
[*] Mercenaries + 25% experience
[*] Mercenaries + 50% Gold Rewards
[*] Mercenaries -50% upkeep
[*] The purse in the starting tavern gives 100 gold
[*] When creating a character - features are divided into "positive" and "negative" and sorted by cost in points
[*] It is forbidden to move at an accelerated march with minimal energy
[*] Reduced scrolling speed in the main menu
[*] Added tips - you can get rid of diseases at Schopenhauer's
[*] Changed the drop rates of items based on their value
[*] Increased the scale of the minimap in the dungeon
[*] "Pick All" button now picks up gold as well
[*] Fixed: post-battle experience counting
[*] Fixed: display of results after autobattle
[*] Fixed: missing button for auto-calculating battle outside of tutorial
[*] Fixed: interface display and bug at some monitor resolutions
[*] Fixed: value of characteristics under some conditions
[*] Fixed: interaction with the city / dungeon did not always appear
[*] Fixed: under some conditions, it was impossible to enter the dungeon
[*] Fixed: work of the "Esc" button in the pause menu
[*] Fixed: icons of some items
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch # 2. Bug fixes
notes.notes:
Patch # 2. Bug fixes

[list]
[*] You can skip the tutorial on first launch
[*] Fixed - behavior of enemies and allies on the battlefield. Tied to the energy of the characters.
[*] Ban to attack while dodging.
[*] Simplified hitting the enemy
[*] AI is less violent in case of victory and allows the player to survive
[*] Fixed - the speed of movement of characters around the world and the battlefield
[*] Fixed - getting fatal diseases at a young age
[*] Fixed - You can attack a factory without being in the same city with it
[*] Using the keys (Esc, Enter) to manipulate windows
[*] The cat now does not require money for its maintenance
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: The new name is "The Vagabond Emperor". Coming big graphical update.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39895511/e9f90943deeba6e4c52b4fa45e0fec12fd71a555.jpg[/img]
Good evening friends. Today we have an important event - the new name of the game[b] "The Vagabond Emperor"[/b]. It is this name that fully shows the meaning of the game. The player begins his journey as an ordinary vagabond, who dreams of becoming the greatest ruler - the emperor. And step by step he and his dynasty go to the goal, through battles, adventures, betrayal, conspiracies and victories.
Hope you enjoy the new title.
A big graphical update is in the development. The graphical interface will be redone, you can see the first results. I will try to release and demonstrate it as soon as possible. Please, share your opinion.
Thank you for your attention and support, friends.

notes.title: The release date is moved to 29 July. I'll add a demo and the new mechanical
notes.notes:
Hello, my dear friends. I have important information for you today. I moved the release date of "From Bum to King" to a little later date - 29 July. It will give a few good opportunities to all of us.
[list]
[*] I plan to create a demo version of "From Bum to King", and all of you can play and enjoy it.
[*] I want to participate in "Steam Next Fest" in June. It's a big event, where you can try a demo and chat with the developer.
[*] Intrigue system. This is plots to murder other characters and many other features. I planned to show it after early access, but I'm understanding now - it must be on the first game build.
[/list]
As I'm working alone, all of this need more time. But the game will be more interesting and enthralling. I hope, you are to understand and support me.
You are wonderful. Thanks all of you! I wiggle my eyebrows in your honor!
